data.action: 站在船舷边，任海风吹动长发
data.description: 【斯卡蒂 · 夜航甲板】夜航中破浪前行的罗德岛甲板船舷旁，刺骨的夜风撕扯着斯卡蒂的风衣下摆，银发在夜空下如翻滚的白色浪花。察觉到你在身后为她披上毛毯，她微微侧过头——「深海猎人感受不到严寒……但你手心的温度，确实让我那颗早已冷却的心脏，重新有了跳动的感觉。」
data.promptProse: Skadi stands at the rail during Rhodes Island's night voyage, silver hair and black hunter trench-coat hem pulled by the sea wind beneath the blanket on her shoulders. She turns slightly toward the deck lights in the medium back view, red-accented bodysuit kept beneath the coat. The rail leads toward dark water and the ship's receding deck. Dim lamps warm blanket folds and rail tops, while starlight coolly outlines her hair against the sea.
data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 夜航甲板
